turns.user: Someone took my mobile phone from my shop on 3 March 2025.
I know who did it. It was my neighbour.
Which section of the Pakistan Penal Code applies to what happened to me, and what is the maximum prison term?

gold.answer: Taking movable property out of someone's possession without consent is theft; section 379 of the Pakistan Penal Code punishes theft with imprisonment of either description up to three years, or fine, or both.

evidence.quote: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years

turns.user: My nephew is 15 years old. Last week he signed a written agreement to sell me his motorcycle.
Sorry, I made a mistake about his age: he is actually 19, not 15.
I paid him 30,000 rupees in advance.
Given his age, which section of the Contract Act, 1872 decides whether he was competent to make this agreement, and was he?

gold.answer: Section 11 of the Contract Act, 1872: a person who is of the age of majority, of sound mind and not disqualified by law is competent to contract. At 19 he has reached majority, so he was competent.

evidence.quote: Every person is competent to contract who is of the age of majority according to the law to which he is subject
